title: The Remains of the Day
creator: Kazuo Ishiguro
summary: An English butler drives across the countryside and constructs a perfect defense of every choice he ever made.
personalNote: Stevens drives across England and constructs a perfect defense of every choice he ever made. By the end you understand exactly why he needed to build it. The restraint is almost unbearable — every scene where he almost says the thing and doesn't. Ishiguro's greatest book, I think. And that's saying something.
favoriteQuote: It is, as I say, a matter of some regret to me that I should have spent so many hours of my life pondering over such questions as the nature of dignity.
